summary: The signed 32-bit input contract fixes the integer width, while the protected source performs one comparison, one subtraction, and one bitwise AND regardless of the value.

workload_bound.source_constraint: The source-fidelity-verified constraint bounds n to the signed 32-bit interval from -2^31 through 2^31 - 1.

replacement_checks.evidence: The source checks positivity and then evaluates n & (n - 1). Under the fixed-width contract, those are a constant number of constant-width operations, proving O(1) time and O(1) auxiliary space.

Black-box real-test execution verifies every existing ordinary check without inspecting its definition; zero, negative values, powers, and non-powers are the material semantic classes for the fixed-width predicate.
